frontier_selector.why: The presence of bilateral naevus flammeus along the ophthalmic and maxillary divisions of the trigeminal nerve and increased choroidal thickness decided it.

support_spans: bilateral naevus flammeus along the ophthalmic and maxillary divisions of the trigeminal nerve, more extensive on the right
iris heterochromia with diffuse hyperpigmentation and evenly distributed micronodular elevations on the iris surface
increased retinal vessel tortuosity and a diffusely darker fundus in the right eye

contradict_spans: MRI of the brain showed no leptomeningeal vascular malformations
